facts.text: The Four Roses distillery, founded in 1888, was built in 1910 in Spanish Mission style and is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
Lawrenceburg was first settled in the early 1780s by German immigrant Jacob Kaufman and was originally called Kaufman's or Coffman's Station.
In addition to Four Roses, the Wild Turkey bourbon distillery also operates in Lawrenceburg, adding to the town’s reputation as a bourbon hub.
The city moved its municipal offices into the historic Old Post Office Building in 1910, preserving a landmark of early 20th-century architecture.
Lawrenceburg’s Anderson Public Library, established in the early 20th century, continues to serve residents with a wide range of books and community programs.
The town was formally incorporated as Lawrence in 1820 and renamed Lawrenceburg in 1827, reflecting its evolving identity.
